title.value: A Bill for an Act Relating to Environmental Protection
title.provenance: A BILL FOR AN ACT RELATING TO ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.

status.provenance: This Act shall take effect on July 1, 2022.

date.provenance: SECTION 3. This Act shall take effect on July 1, 2022.

pfas_definition.provenance: "Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances" or "PFAS" means all members of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: prohibit the manufacture, sale, or distribution for sale or use of wraps and liners, plates, food boats, and pizza boxes that contain PFAS

date.provenance: Beginning December 31, 2024, it shall be unlawful to manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State any food packaging specified in subsection (b) to which PFAS chemicals have been intentionally introduced in any amount.

who.provenance: it shall be unlawful to manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State any food packaging

action.provenance: it shall be unlawful to manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in the State any food packaging

products.provenance: The prohibition under this section shall apply to wraps and liners, plates, food boats, and pizza boxes.

intentionally_added.provenance: "Intentionally introduced" means deliberately utilized PFAS in the formulation of a package or packaging component where the continued presence of the PFAS is desired in the final package or packaging component to provide a specific characteristic, appearance, or quality.

type.provenance: prohibit the manufacture, sale, distribution, and use of class B firefighting foams that contain PFAS

date.provenance: Beginning July 1, 2024, it shall be unlawful for any person or state or county department or agency to discharge or otherwise use for training or testing purposes class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally introduced PFAS chemicals

who.provenance: it shall be unlawful for any person or state or county department or agency to discharge or otherwise use for training or testing purposes class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally introduced PFAS chemicals

value: Distribute for training or testing purposes
action.provenance: it shall be unlawful to manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for training or testing purposes in the State any class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally introduced PFAS chemicals

products.provenance: "Class B firefighting foam" means foams designed to suppress flammable liquid fires.

value: effective suppression of a petroleum fire
exceptions.provenance: This section shall not apply to the manufacture, sale, or distribution of class B firefighting foam where the inclusion of PFAS chemicals is required by federal law or regulations; ... unless the use is necessary for effective suppression of a petroleum fire.

intentionally_added.provenance: "Intentionally introduced" means deliberately utilized PFAS in the formulation of a package or packaging component where the continued presence of the PFAS is desired in the final package or packaging component to provide a specific characteristic, appearance, or quality.
